{{Quote|Your orders are to go to Bela Vistal and listen in on a meeting of Imperial officers. With luck, they'll let slip the location of some starships the Empire has taken from us.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SS" />}}
An '''Imperial Base''' in the [[Dregan's Pike]] region of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This base was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:SS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> this base was used as a hiding spot for several stolen [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wings]]. The Empire hoped to use these X-Wings for illicit purposes, in an attempt to turn public opinion against the Rebel Alliance. However, a Rebel operative working for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] overheard two [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] discussing this plan in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]]. To pave the way for disrupting their plans, a group of Rebel operatives set off towards the base, [[Mission to Bela Vistal|eliminated]] a number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] guards, and destroyed three security terminals within the base's bunker. A Rebel recovery team eventually managed to recover 85% of the stolen starships.<ref name="SWG:SS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Base was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]]," released with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]," on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
